description: Update an existing Status Page Announcement in OneUptime. Only include the fields you want to change - unspecified fields will remain unchanged. Use get_status_page_announcement afterwards to see the updated record.

description.description: Text of the announcement. This can be in Markdown format.

id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the Status Page Announcement to update. Required. Use list_status_page_announcements to find IDs.

monitors.description: List of monitors affected by this announcement. If none are selected, all subscribers will be notified.

showAnnouncementAt.description: When should this announcement be shown?

statusPages.description: Status Pages to show show this announcement on.

name: update_status_page_announcement
title: Update Status Page Announcement
